text: The authors define mnip as nip with two provers sharing the same loss, with soundness required against any choice of both provers. Theorem 11 states that, for a problem with a valid proof system, a profile is a valid multi-prover interactive proof system if and only if it is an approximate verifier-leading correlated Stackelberg equilibrium, correlated equilibria being needed because the provers can coordinate on a joint strategy beforehand.
title: Theorem 11: two-prover mnip equilibria correspond to valid multi-prover interactive proofs
